newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $114/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $114/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, USDA said. On a dressed basis deliverered (paid on hot carcass weights), steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher.

Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1325 lbs 113.00- 114.00. (weighted average 113.43) Dressed Basis Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1225 lbs mostly 114.00, load 112.00 (weighted average 113.73)
Slaughter steers and heifers not established on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand light, seller interest light.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 1,500 Last Week - 600 Last Year - 800 Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr - None.
